currentHeadFindings.title: Retry ownership registration for the launched root
currentHeadFindings.author: chatgpt-codex-connector
currentHeadFindings.originalText:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Retry ownership registration for the launched root**

If the first `details(rootpid)` call fails transiently immediately after `Popen`, this now leaves `owned` empty; `run_stage` still enters `closure`, but `discover` can only register processes whose parent is already owned, so it cannot rediscover the root itself, `remaining` is empty, and no TERM is sent to the live Unity process. Restoration then remains blocked by the unowned consumer. This is fresh evidence beyond the prior partial-entry finding because the new replay covers child recovery only; retry root registration from a fresh snapshot before closure decides there is nothing to stop.
